bullets.text: Gummidipoondi police formed two special teams to catch a government bus conductor who abducted a 14-year-old girl, and the office should monitor the rescue.
Chennai experienced heavy rain while heavy to very heavy rain is forecasted for Thiruvallur and Kancheepuram districts today, and the office must watch weather alerts.
Police arrested two young men for smuggling ganja on a bus near Gummidipoondi, and the district team should monitor local anti-narcotics enforcement.
Chennai Metro Rail Limited announced new names and a better look for Phase 2 stations from Poonamallee to Vadapalani, and the office should watch project updates.
A sthapathi was injured after falling from the rajagopuram work at the Tiruttani Murugan temple, and the office should check on medical assistance.
CapitaLand inaugurated a new data centre in Ambattur, Chennai, in the presence of Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, and the portfolio team should track infrastructure growth.
Canadian Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu stated that Canadian companies want to deepen partnerships with Karnataka in AI and quantum computing, and the office should monitor tech trends.
IIT BHU in Varanasi is hosting an AI for Healthcare and Assistive Technologies conclave, and the portfolio team should review medical AI applications.
